scope: Representative current employer JDs plus primary SAP product documentation; not an exhaustive live SAP jobs census
method: Use employer JDs as customer-specific requirements
Use SAP Learning/Help as technical domain definitions
Do not turn a customer preference or job threshold into a universal parser rule
Preserve source-stated product, edition, task, involvement and project dates
Validate changes against CV sources before accuracy claims

customer_requirements: FICO process knowledge
A stated specialty such as FSCM, Treasury, Cash, FICA, costing, consolidation or Central Finance
Public Edition and completed implementation cycles when explicitly required
do_not_infer: Public Edition experience from generic S/4HANA

customer_requirements: Planning, freight orders, carrier selection, charges and settlement
Separately evidenced program leadership, client advisory and presales
Separate overall SAP tenure from TM-specific tenure
Identify EWM versus TM responsibilities independently
Check the role-specific language requirement against source
do_not_infer: EWM proficiency from classic WM, MM deliveries, warehouse industry or TM integration

customer_requirements: Separate application development and architecture from functional delivery
Track actual CAP/RAP/ABAP technologies and project responsibility
do_not_infer: ABAP expertise from CAP; CAP supports Node.js/Java
Coding expertise from using Fiori apps
Functional specialty ownership from developing an extension

customer_requirements: Employee Central Payroll/PCC and payroll process experience
Country payroll and release context
Read certification and implementation/support requirements literally
do_not_infer: ECP experience from Employee Central alone
All SuccessFactors modules from one certification

customer_requirements: Identify actual configured modules and integrations
Preserve preferred versus required certification wording
do_not_infer: Talent Management acronym TM means transportation
A role title proves every SuccessFactors module

customer_requirements: Technical landscape, operations, migration, continuity and architecture responsibility
Distinguish certifications preferred from mandatory
do_not_infer: BASIS skills from daily basis or Solution Manager use
Application module expertise from operating its landscape

customer_requirements: Identify incident response versus application authorization/GRC duties
Read tools and security responsibilities independently
do_not_infer: GRC Access Control ownership from generic security or BASIS

customer_requirements: Requisitioning, purchasing, sourcing/contracts, configuration and edition context
do_not_infer: ABAP skill from writing functional RICEF specifications
All MM/Ariba capabilities from generic procurement

implemented_this_revision: Three EWM task areas with explicit EWM domain guard
UI5/RAP/CAP coding tasks distinguished from functional delivery
not_yet_implemented_from_research: Edition evidence validation across all CVs
Universal leadership or full-lifecycle project counting
